lines.japanese: 冬の夜道、吹いてくる風は冷たかった。
lines.english: The wind on the winter streets was cold that night.

lines.japanese: 一月になれば、十二月よりも当然気温は下がる。だがこんな凍えるように寒いのは、正面からの風に対して、遮蔽物がないからだ。
lines.english: January was naturally colder than December. But it felt this bitter because nothing shielded us from the wind blowing straight into our faces.

lines.japanese: こんなとき、兄として、震える妹の肩をそっと抱いてあげられたなら。
lines.english: At a time like this, if only I could gently put an arm around my shivering sister's shoulders, as a brother should.
“...Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 俺はいつもより気持ちハンサムな顔で振りかえった。
lines.english: I turned around with an expression slightly more handsome than usual.

lines.japanese: だが寒さから守るべき妹は、遥か１０メートル後方を歩いていた。
lines.english: But the sister I was meant to protect from the cold was walking a full ten meters behind me.

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうしたんだ小鳩。そんなに離れてたら、会話もできないじゃないか」
lines.english: “Wh-what's wrong, Kobato? We can't even talk when you're that far away.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、なに？　聞こえない」
lines.english: “What? I can't hear you.”

lines.japanese: うん、だろうね。小鳩が離れた位置にいるからね。
lines.english: Yes. I assumed as much. Because you're so far away.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、もしかして、お兄ちゃんの歩くのが速すぎたかな？　よし、それならもっとゆっくり歩いて――」
lines.english: “Oh! Am I walking too fast? All right, then I'll slow—”

lines.japanese: ずんずんずん！
lines.english: Stomp, stomp, stomp!

lines.japanese: 彼女にしては速い歩みで、俺と歩くときの定位置にやって来た。
lines.english: Walking quickly for her, she returned to her usual position beside me.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんねお兄ちゃん、なに？」
lines.english: “Sorry, Big Brother. What did you say?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……なにって言うか……」
lines.english: “Nothing... I mean...”

lines.japanese: なんか、その……。
lines.english: Something just seemed...

lines.japanese: 小鳩さん、ご機嫌斜めじゃありません……？
lines.english: Miss Kobato, might you be in a foul mood...?

lines.japanese: 通行人の皆さんは、もちろん俺たちに無関心。それでも俺は、周りの目を気にして小声で尋ねる。
lines.english: The other pedestrians naturally paid us no attention. Even so, conscious of their eyes, I lowered my voice before asking.

lines.japanese: 「な、なあ小鳩……俺もしかして、小鳩を怒らせるようなこと言ったか？」
lines.english: “Hey, Kobato... Did I say something that made you angry?”

lines.japanese: 「え、どういうこと」
lines.english: “What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だって、いま機嫌悪いみたいだし」
lines.english: “Well, you seem like you're in a bad mood.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？　私フツーだよね？」
lines.english: “Why? I'm acting normal, aren't I?”

lines.japanese: 「ええー」
lines.english: “Come on...”

lines.japanese: フツーちゃうやん……。
lines.english: This ain't normal...

lines.japanese: 「それだけ？　それならもういいよね。早く帰ろうよ」
lines.english: “Is that all? Then we're done, right? Let's hurry home.”

lines.japanese: さらに普段よりもクール＆ドライ二割増くらいの物言いだった。これじゃまるで、玉泉日和子でも乗りうつったみたいじゃないか。
lines.english: Even her manner was about twenty percent cooler and drier than usual. It was almost as if Hiyoko Tamaizumi had possessed her.

lines.japanese: 腐った魚のような目の小鳩を想像して、俺はその恐ろしさに身を震わせた。
lines.english: I imagined Kobato with the eyes of a dead fish and trembled at the horror.

lines.japanese: 「な、なあ小鳩。鳳鳴にも言ったことだけど、なにか思ってることがあるなら、お兄ちゃんにどんどん話してごらん」
lines.english: “H-hey, Kobato. I said the same thing to Naru Ohtori: if something's on your mind, you can tell Big Brother anything.”

lines.japanese: 「んー……特にないよ」
lines.english: “Hmm... Nothing in particular.”

lines.japanese: 「と、特にないってこともないでしょー。お兄ちゃんに話せることも、何もないっていうの小鳩はー！」
lines.english: “Th-there has to be something! Are you saying there's nothing at all you can tell your big brother, Kobato?”

lines.japanese: 「なっ、なんで。だってさっきから、わたし怒ってないって言ってるのに。怒ってるのお兄ちゃんの方だよ」
lines.english: “Wh-why? I've been telling you I'm not angry this whole time. You're the one who's getting angry.”

lines.japanese: 「ななっ、なんてこと言うの！　俺が怒るわけないでしょ、しかも小鳩に対して！　ただ小鳩がはっきり言わないから」
lines.english: “Wh-what are you talking about?! I could never be angry, especially with Kobato! I'm only saying you won't tell me clearly.”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だって、ほんとに何もないもん。ただ……」
lines.english: “B-but there really isn't anything. It's just...”

lines.japanese: 「ただっ！？」
lines.english: “Just what?!”

lines.japanese: 俺が声を荒げると、小鳩は少し怯みかけた。
lines.english: When I raised my voice, Kobato nearly shrank back.

lines.japanese: しかし、すぐに眉を寄せて強気に出る。いつも消極的な小鳩のがんばる姿に、そんな場合じゃないと知りつつ、お兄ちゃんはちょっと感激した。
lines.english: But she quickly knitted her brows and stood her ground. Though I knew this was hardly the time, Big Brother was a little moved to see the usually passive Kobato putting up a fight.

lines.japanese: が、結局すぐに小鳩の士気は横へ逸れた。
lines.english: But her fighting spirit soon took a different tack.

lines.japanese: 「お、お兄ちゃん……鳴ちゃんさんと話すの好き？」
lines.english: “B-Big Brother... Do you like talking to Miss Naru?”

lines.japanese: 「へっ、鳴ちゃんさん？」
lines.english: “Huh? Miss Naru?”

lines.japanese: 鳳鳴？
lines.english: Naru Ohtori?

lines.japanese: なぜここで鳳鳴出てきた？
lines.english: Why had Naru Ohtori come up now?

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんが鳴ちゃんさんと話してるとき、ぜんぜん切れ間もなくって」
lines.english: “When you were talking to Miss Naru, there wasn't a break at all.”

lines.japanese: 「鳴ちゃんさんと話すの、すごく楽しそうだった」
lines.english: “You looked like you were having so much fun with her.”

lines.japanese: 「え、そう？」
lines.english: “Did I?”

lines.japanese: そんなことないと思うけど……俺、誰が相手でもあんな感じだし。
lines.english: I didn't think so... I was like that with anybody.

lines.japanese: 「鳴ちゃんさんと話してるときのお兄ちゃんは、ユキお姉ちゃんと話してるときのケンお兄さんみたいだった」
lines.english: “When you talk to Miss Naru, you look the way Ken did when he talked to Yuki.”

lines.japanese: 「なっ」
lines.english: “Wha—”

lines.japanese: 俺は少なからず動揺した。
lines.english: That shook me more than a little.

lines.japanese: ユキ姉──かつて俺たちが公団住宅に住んでいたころ、同じ棟に住んでいた女性。幼かった俺の、憧れのひと。
lines.english: Yuki—the woman who’d lived in the same building back when we lived in public housing. Someone I’d looked up to as a little boy.

lines.japanese: そして小鳩は、そのことに少なからず不満を持っていた（っぽいことを前に言われた気がする）。
lines.english: And Kobato had not been entirely happy about that. (Or at least, I seemed to recall her saying something like that once.)

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ、なんだそれ。だってユキ姉とケン兄って言ったら、付きあってたじゃないの。それじゃまるで、俺と鳳鳴が……ばばばば馬鹿言っちゃいけません！」
lines.english: “W-wait, what does that mean? Yuki and Ken were dating. You're making it sound as if Naru Ohtori and I... D-d-don't be ridiculous!”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だって、あの時と同じ感じしたもん」
lines.english: “B-but it felt just like it did then.”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、ユキお姉ちゃんとばっかり話して、私にはおかしだけ渡して知らんぷりだった」
lines.english: “You talked to Yuki the whole time. You just gave me candy and ignored me.”

lines.japanese: 「ち、違うだろ。あれはみんなで輪になって面白い話しようと、俺は子供心にがんばって──」
lines.english: “Th-that's not true. We were all in a circle, and in my childish way, I was trying to keep everybody entertained—”

lines.japanese: ──いやちょっと待て。なんでいま、そんな急に昔の話を。
lines.english: —No, wait. Why was she suddenly bringing that up now?

lines.japanese: それは小鳩が、鳳鳴にユキ姉を重ねたからだ。
lines.english: Because Naru Ohtori had reminded Kobato of Yuki.

lines.japanese: 綺麗なお姉さんに鼻の下を伸ばして、妹をほったらかしていた兄。
lines.english: Her brother making eyes at a beautiful older girl and leaving his little sister by herself.

lines.japanese: 「もしかして、小鳩……」
lines.english: “Wait, Kobato...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「拗ねてたのか」
lines.english: “Were you sulking?”

lines.japanese: その言葉を口にした瞬間、いつも穏やかな小鳩の顔にみるみる火が灯っていった。
lines.english: The instant I said it, fire rapidly spread across Kobato's ordinarily placid face.

lines.japanese: 「ちっ、ちがくてっ」
lines.english: “N-no, I wasn't!”

lines.japanese: 「ちがくないだろ。だっていまの話だと、まるで俺が鳳鳴のことを、ユキ姉みたいに好きだって言ってるようなもん――」
lines.english: “Yes, you were. From what you're saying, you'd think I liked Naru Ohtori the way I liked Yuki—”

lines.japanese: 「あっ！　いま、ユキお姉ちゃんが好きだったってみとめた！」
lines.english: “Ah! You just admitted you liked Yuki!”

lines.japanese: 「――だぶうっ！？」
lines.english: “—Bghwah?!”

lines.japanese: しまった、今まで完璧に隠しとおしてきた幼き日の恋心が！
lines.english: Damn it! The boyhood crush I had concealed perfectly all these years!

lines.japanese: 「なな、なっ、なんてこと言わせんの！　違う違うよ、今のノーカン！　だって小鳩にそう言わされたようなもんじゃん！」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-why would you make me say that?! No, no, it doesn't count! You practically forced the words out of me!”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなことないよ！　お兄ちゃんが自分から言ったんだよ。お兄ちゃんがユキお姉ちゃんばっかり見てるの、ケンお兄さんにもバレてたし」
lines.english: “I-I did not! You said it yourself! Even Ken noticed how you only ever looked at Yuki.”

lines.japanese: 「ヴぁれてなァーい！　ヴぁっ、ヴぁれてなァーい！」
lines.english: “He diiidn't! H-he diiidn't!”

lines.japanese: 「今日だって、ずっと鳴ちゃんさんの方ばっかり見てた」
lines.english: “Even today, all you did was look at Miss Naru.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うぐっ」
lines.english: “U-urgh.”

lines.japanese: ぐぞ、鳳鳴にばかりかまけてたつもりはないのに、ユキ姉のことを出されると俺の分が悪い。
lines.english: Damn. I hadn't meant to pay attention only to Naru Ohtori, but once Kobato brought up Yuki, I was at a disadvantage.

lines.japanese: このままでは言い訳の一つもできやしない。ならばここは、兄としての威厳を守るため──
lines.english: At this rate, I couldn't make a single excuse. Then, to preserve my dignity as an elder brother—

lines.japanese: ──逆ギレだあ！
lines.english: —time to get mad at her instead!

lines.japanese: 「だ、だってそれ言ったら、鳳鳴を連れてきたのは小鳩だったぞ！」
lines.english: “B-but you're the one who brought Naru Ohtori along!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「きょ、今日は小鳩とふたりでご飯だと思って楽しみにしてたのに、校門へ行ったら鳳鳴がいるし」
lines.english: “I-I'd been looking forward to dinner alone with Kobato today, but when I reached the school gate, there was Naru Ohtori.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、あの、それは……ぐうぜん会っちゃったから……」
lines.english: “What? Um, that was... because we happened to run into each other...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いやいや、それを責めてるわけじゃないぞ。だけど小鳩とふたりきりの食事がなくなって、ちょっと寂しかったお兄ちゃんの気持ちも分かってくれ」
lines.english: “N-no, I'm not blaming you. But try to understand how your big brother felt when he lost his dinner alone with Kobato and got a little lonely.”

lines.japanese: 「え……さみしかったの？」
lines.english: “What...? You were lonely?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、まあ、寂しかったって言うか……」
lines.english: “Y-yeah. Well, not exactly lonely...”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？」
lines.english: “Then why?”

lines.japanese: うっ、それを言えってのか。
lines.english: Urgh. She wanted me to say it?

lines.japanese: よく見れば、さっきまで熱くなって朱の乗っていた唇が、いつもの淡い桃色に戻っている。
lines.english: Looking closely, her lips, flushed scarlet with heat moments ago, had returned to their usual pale pink.

lines.japanese: 「い、いやだからさあ……」
lines.english: “W-well, because...”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm-hmm.”

lines.japanese: 「いやその……わ、分かるだろ？　小鳩だって子供じゃないんだから」
lines.english: “I mean... y-you understand, don't you? You're not a child anymore, Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、わたし子供だよ」
lines.english: “No. I am a child.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはあっ」
lines.english: “Bwah!”

lines.japanese: な、なんて子だ、自分の立場を最大限利用しやがった。おとなしそうに見えて、もう小鳩にも女のずるさは備わっていたということか。
lines.english: Wh-what a girl. She had exploited her position to the fullest. Quiet as she looked, had Kobato already acquired a woman's cunning?

lines.japanese: 小鳩の目は、ある種の言葉を期待している。
lines.english: Kobato's eyes waited expectantly for a certain kind of words.

lines.japanese: 普段はさんざん大安売りしているたぐいの言葉だけど、こうも改まって待ちかまえられては、意味合いがまったく違ってくる。
lines.english: They were words I normally sold by the dozen, but with her waiting for them so solemnly, they took on an entirely different meaning.

lines.japanese: 本気っぽくなってしまうのだ。
lines.english: They would sound sincere.

lines.japanese: 「だ、だからさあ、その……なんつうか？　つまりはだなあ、なんつうか？　つうかなんつうかさあ、だからなんつうか──」
lines.english: “S-so, um... How do I put it? What I mean is, you know... How do I put it? Or rather, how do I put this? So, you know—”

lines.japanese: 「──言わなきゃ駄目？」
lines.english: “—Do I have to say it?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm-hmm.”

lines.japanese: きらきら光る眼差しにあてられ、俺は自棄になった。
lines.english: Overwhelmed by the sparkle in her eyes, I gave in to desperation.

lines.japanese: 「こっ！　小鳩とふたりで、手を繋いだりしたかったなあ！　みたいな……」
lines.english: “I-I wanted to be alone with Kobato and maybe hold hands! Something like that...”

lines.japanese: 口にした瞬間、顔からヘラクレスが出るほど恥ずかしくなった。
lines.english: The instant the words left my mouth, I was embarrassed enough for Hercules to burst from my face.

lines.japanese: 「えへっ」
lines.english: “Heehee.”

lines.japanese: しかし小鳩が笑顔に戻ってくれたから、後悔はなかった。
lines.english: But Kobato smiled again, so I had no regrets.

lines.japanese: 「私もお兄ちゃんと話すの、楽しみにしてたのかも」
lines.english: “I think maybe I was looking forward to talking to you too, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「いっつも同じ家にいるのに、ヘンだよね」
lines.english: “We're always in the same house. It's strange, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなことない」
lines.english: “N-no, it isn't.”

lines.japanese: と思う。やはり家で話すのと、ふたりで外を歩くのとは違う。
lines.english: I didn't think it was. Talking at home and walking outside together were different things.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんねお兄ちゃん。わがままなこと言って」
lines.english: “Sorry, Big Brother. I said something selfish.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、俺の方こそ大人げなかった……」
lines.english: “N-no, I was the one acting childish...”

lines.japanese: 往来で頭を下げあう兄妹。
lines.english: Brother and sister bowed to each other in the middle of the street.

lines.japanese: 我に返ってみると、正面からの北風に気付く。上気しているせいか、いまは寒さが気にならなかった。
lines.english: When I came to my senses, I noticed the north wind blowing into our faces. Perhaps because my blood was still up, the cold no longer bothered me.

lines.japanese: 「よし、じゃあ帰ろう」
lines.english: “All right. Let's go home.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん」
lines.english: “O-okay.”

lines.japanese: 我が家へ足を向ける。隣りに並んだ小鳩の手が、白くなった俺の指先に触れた。
lines.english: We turned toward home. Kobato's hand brushed against my cold-white fingertips as she fell into step beside me.

lines.japanese: 暗がりの中で俯いているものだから、彼女の表情はよく確認できない。
lines.english: Her head was bowed in the darkness, so I couldn't make out her expression.
“Kobato...”

lines.japanese: 俺はこっそり触れてきた小さな手を、しっかりと握りかえした。
lines.english: I firmly closed my hand around the small one that had secretly reached for mine.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そだ……けっこう寒いよな、今日……」
lines.english: “R-right... It's pretty cold today...”

lines.japanese: 妹の手を離さないために、俺はそんな言いわけをした。
lines.english: I made the excuse so I would not have to release my sister's hand.
“Y-yeah...”

lines.japanese: 「寒かったら、手ぇ握っても仕方ないよな。温めるためなら、変じゃないよな」
lines.english: “If it's cold, we don't have much choice but to hold hands. There's nothing strange about it if we're warming each other up.”

lines.japanese: 「変じゃないよ。ぜんぜん変じゃないよ」
lines.english: “Nothing strange at all. Not a bit.”

lines.japanese: 「だよなあ。俺たち、仲良し兄妹だもんなあ」
lines.english: “Right. We're a close brother and sister.”

lines.japanese: 「手つないだって兄妹だもん、ぜんぜん変じゃないよ。変ってゆうひとは頭おかしいんだよ」
lines.english: “We're still brother and sister when we hold hands. There's nothing strange about it. Anyone who says it is strange is crazy.”

lines.japanese: 俺たちは照れ臭さをおちゃらけて誤魔化しながら帰った。
lines.english: We walked home, hiding our embarrassment behind jokes.

lines.japanese: 繋いだ手と手の間には、汗がもりもり滲んでいた。
lines.english: Sweat poured freely between our joined hands.
